'''Kalist Base''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] prison facility located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalist VI/Legends|Kalist VI]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. The prison itself consisted of a massive [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] dome, with a landing platform and several power fences surrounding the perimeter.

==History==
Since the early days of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the Kalist VI labor colony was used to hold, among others, [[Politics/Legends|political]] dissidents and prisoners of war. Two such political prisoners were the [[Dak Ralter's parents|parents]] of [[Dak Ralter/Legends|Dak Ralter]], children of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. Ralter himself was born into captivity inside the complex.

Born inside the prison, Ralter only knew [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as a place of fear, oppression, and the Empire. What little knowledge he had of the outside world came from stories his parents told him, and what little information he could cobble together from the newly imprisoned. He longed for a life of freedom. His opportunity to escape came when he met a new prisoner named [[Breg]], whom Ralter learned was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], downed during a reconnaissance mission. The two managed to escape the prison by first vaulting the inner and outer power fences and stealing two guard uniforms. They then triggered a false reactor alarm, staged a prearranged power outage, and boarded an [[Imperial prison barge]], which they used to blast away from the planet. During the escape, Breg was mortally wounded by an Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]], but Ralter managed to survive and start a new life with the Rebellion.

Approximately eight months after the Battle of Yavin, the Empire took [[Jabiimi]] prisoners, as well as [[Jorin Sol]], to this base where the Jabiimi were used for slave labor and Sol was tortured for information regarding the location of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. A Rebel team, including [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], successfully infiltrated the base, posing as the crew of the Imperial tanker ''[[Nuna's Twins]]'', with the intention of retrieving Sol. Luring most of the base's troops off-planet and into a [[Ambush at Thila|trap]], the Rebels rescued Sol and the prisoners, causing heavy damage to the base. After the attack, the base was repaired and reinforced quickly.
